name: aws-secure-ops
description: Dual-runtime AWS CLI guardrails: full Claude protocol and fail-closed read-only Codex enforcement.

interface.shortDescription: Operate AWS CLI with fail-closed read-only guardrails.
interface.longDescription: Adds a secure AWS operating skill, a fail-closed pre-execution gate, and a session watchdog. In Codex it permits only explicit, bounded, non-sensitive reads through a policy-classified read-only profile; all mutations are blocked.
defaultPrompt: Preflight a safe read-only AWS CLI command.
Plan a bounded read-only AWS investigation.
Review an AWS change without executing it.
